_doc: Who runs this: the WBS owner-cell name the plan keeps (the bare name, name<-other, other->name). EMPTY = no owner filter, every owner's rows of the day go into the worklist. Set it per machine in <WorkDir>/ebi.local.json { "operator": { "owner": "<name>" } } -- the repo copy stays blank (no personal names in the repo).
_silent_doc: true = silent mode (same as ebi.ps1 -Silent): windows stay behind while you work on something else -- only a step that must see or type into a page (Edge, DF) takes the front for its moment, and a question brings the console. Per machine in ebi.local.json { "operator": { "silent": true } }.
_reviewer_doc: gfixRecv.deliver: the review check sheet's 確認 column (H) for the rows this operator adds, as the sheet writes it (a family name). Per machine in ebi.local.json, like owner.
